rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, identified the correct order containing the earbuds, confirmed the change before writing, successfully modified the pending order to the requested blue variant at a lower price, and processed a refund with correct amount and payment method. However, the agent then stated, “No further modifications or cancellations can be made to this order,” which is not supported by the tools or the provided policy (the order remained pending). This constitutes unsupported information, triggering a failure under the policy’s requirement to avoid fabricated or unsupported statements.
